body:
Bison Whistle says "If it's a creature card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it into your graveyard."

The graveyard choice is offered for any card, including a creature card.

Old: `[PutTopOfLibraryInGraveyard]`
New: the graveyard choice only when it isn't a creature card

comments.body:
You're reading it incorrectly, and there's a goal to never leak information about the top card of the library, so you don't want to offer a choice inside of an ``If(TopCardOfLibraryIs(...)), { ... }`` style block.

You look at the top card of the library and have 4 choices:
```
Put On Battlefield (if it's a Bison),
Reveal and Put in Hand (if it's a Creature) (or if it's a Bison, because all Bison are creatures and you refused the above option)
Put In Graveyard (any card, you can if it's a bison or a creature too, because you refused the above two options)
Leave it on top of library (any card, because you refused the top three options)
```

title: Bison Whistle: graveyard choice isn't limited to "otherwise"
